div.head: AGu 1
div.ab: Ærest ymbe heora landgemæra: andlang Témese, þ[onne] up on Ligean, andlang Ligean oð hire æwylm, ðanon on gerihta to Bedaforda, þanon upon on Usan oð Wætlingastrǽt.
Ærest ymb ure landgemæra: up on Temese, ⁊ ðonne up on Ligan, ⁊ andlang Ligan oð hire æwylm, ðonne on gerihte to Bedanforda, ðonne up on Usan oð Wætlingastræt.

Inprimis de nostris landimeris (commarcionibus): sursum in Tamesi et tunc superius in Ligan et tunc in longum usque ad exortum eius, tunc in rectum ad Bedefordium, tunc sursum in Usa ad þetelingastret.
Ærest ymb ure landgemæra: up on Temese, ⁊ ðonne up on Ligan, ⁊ andlang Ligan oð hire æwylm, ðonne on gerihte to Bedanforda, ðonne up on Usan oð Wætlingastræt.

First as to the boundaries between us. [They shall run] up the Thames, and then up to the Lea, and then along the Lea to its source, then in a straight line to Bedford, and then up the Ouse to Watling Street.
First concerning our boundaries: up the Thames, and then up the Lea, and along the Lea to its source, then in a straight line to Bedford, then up the Ouse to the Watling Street.

Erstens betreffend unsere (ihre B2) Landesgrenzen: aufwärts an (entlang B2) der Themse und dann aufwärts an der Lea und entlang der Lea bis zu ihrer Quelle, dann in gerader Richtung nach Bedford, dann aufwärts an der Ouse bis zur Watlingstrasse.
First concerning our (their B2) boundaries: up the Thames (along B2) and then up the Lea, and along the Lea to its source, then in a straight line to Bedford, then up the Ouse to Watling Street.
div.note: for up on meaning “up” cf. the Chronicle 895
